messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Report writing workflow: decouple steps of writing of code and document.
parts:
1. Generally speaking, if a project has both a Google Group and a
Github issues page, broad discussions like this are better on the
group with the issues page reserved for things like bug reports and
smallish feature requests.

2. I don't think any two coders have *ever* had the same "optimum
workflow" unless they're working on a project together and the
environment is mandated by the people who write the paychecks.
Everything works for small projects and nothing works for big ones.
;-)
